description: Podio is a work-management platform with a full programmable API for integrations and apps.
auth_notes: OAuth2 flows (server-side, client-side, username/password) plus app authentication using a per-app app token for scripts.
gate_detail: Any free or paid Podio account can grab an API key from account settings; both have full API access. Some destructive operations need an increased trust level via support request. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Described as a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality, with client wrappers for PHP, .NET, Ruby, Java, Python, Android and Objective-C.
mcp_notes: Podio External MCP Server on podio.com domain; OAuth2 authorization code flow; streamable HTTP transport.
blocker_detail: Trust-level increase needed only for restricted destructive operations; rate limits can be raised via support.
